ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(
SELECT DISTINCT
BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
,'NA' AS CustomerId
,CONVERT(datetime, BDA.START_DATE) AS PeriodStartDate
,CONVERT(datetime, BDA.END_DATE) AS PeriodEndDate
,BDA.CUST_ID AS CoreCustomerId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,BDA.DEL_FLG AS DeletedIndicator
,BDA.GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT AS GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,BDA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,BDA.PROFIT_CERT_FLG AS ProfitCertificateIndicator
,BDA.ENTITY_CRE_FLG AS VerifiedIndicator
,BDA.MINOR_MAJOR_LET_GEN_FLG AS MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,BDA.CHNGD_DUE_TO_ASSUMPTN_FLG AS ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,BDA.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM AS SerialNumber
,BDA.ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD AS RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,BDA.CUST_RELTN_CODE AS CustomerRelationCode
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,NULL AS LinkCode
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
FROM BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP BDA
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDA.ACID AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
where BDA.ISLATEST = '1'
)



SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
WHERE CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(varchar,CoreCustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountParticipationNote)
,convert(char,DeletedIndicator)
,convert(integer,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(char,ProfitCertificateIndicator)
,convert(char,VerifiedIndicator)
,convert(char,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator)
,convert(char,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator)
,convert(varchar,SerialNumber)
,convert(integer,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount)
,convert(varchar,CustomerRelationCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, SerialNumber,PeriodStartDate, CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
)
 --2540271 2540271
,

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(varchar,CoreCustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountParticipationNote)
,convert(char,DeletedIndicator)
,convert(integer,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(char,ProfitCertificateIndicator)
,convert(char,VerifiedIndicator)
,convert(char,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator)
,convert(char,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator)
,convert(varchar,SerialNumber)
,convert(integer,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount)
,convert(varchar,CustomerRelationCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, SerialNumber, PeriodStartDate, CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'DEP'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,ISNULL(SRC.SerialNumber,TGT.SerialNumber) AS SerialNumber
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartDate,TGT.PeriodStartDate) AS PeriodStartDate
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.SerialNumber = TGT.SerialNumber
AND SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT *INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndDate = DATEADD(Day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartDate)
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND  DELTA.SerialNumber = TGT.SerialNumber 
AND  DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND  DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.SerialNumber = TGT.SerialNumber
AND SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'



--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation
(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,CoreCustomerId
,CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,DeletedIndicator
,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,FinancialInstitutionId
,ProfitCertificateIndicator
,VerifiedIndicator
,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SerialNumber
,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,CustomerRelationCode
,CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,LinkCode
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT DISTINCT
 SRC.CustomerAccountId
,SRC.CustomerId
,SRC.PeriodStartDate
,SRC.PeriodEndDate
,SRC.CoreCustomerId
,SRC.CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,SRC.DeletedIndicator
,SRC.GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.ProfitCertificateIndicator
,SRC.VerifiedIndicator
,SRC.MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,SRC.ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SRC.SerialNumber
,SRC.RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,SRC.CustomerRelationCode
,SRC.CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,SRC.LinkCode
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,SRC.WorkFlowId
,SRC.TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
AND DELTA.SerialNumber = SRC.SerialNumber
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;


END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTPARTICIPATION_LNS] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation AS (
SELECT
	BLG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,NULL AS CustomerId
	,BLA.START_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BLA.END_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
	,NULL AS LinkCode
	,BLA.DEL_FLG AS DeletedIndicator
	,BLA.GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT AS GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
	,BLA.PROFIT_CERT_FLG AS ProfitCertificateIndicator
	,BLA.ENTITY_CRE_FLG AS VerifiedIndicator
	,BLA.MINOR_MAJOR_LET_GEN_FLG AS MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
	,BLA.CHNGD_DUE_TO_ASSUMPTN_FLG AS ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
	,BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM AS SerialNumber
	,BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD AS RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
	,BLA.CUST_ID AS CoreCustomerId
	,BLA.CUST_RELTN_CODE AS CustomerRelationCode
	,BLA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
FROM BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN BLA
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG ON BLA.ACID = BLG.ACID AND BLG.ISLATEST = 1  
where BLA.ISLATEST = 1 

)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(char,DeletedIndicator)
,convert(integer,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage)
,convert(char,ProfitCertificateIndicator)
,convert(char,VerifiedIndicator)
,convert(char,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator)
,convert(char,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator)
,convert(varchar,SerialNumber)
,convert(integer,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount)
,convert(varchar,CoreCustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerRelationCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, SerialNumber, CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(char,DeletedIndicator)
,convert(integer,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage)
,convert(char,ProfitCertificateIndicator)
,convert(char,VerifiedIndicator)
,convert(char,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator)
,convert(char,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator)
,convert(varchar,SerialNumber)
,convert(integer,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount)
,convert(varchar,CoreCustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerRelationCode)
)) HASHROW,  CustomerAccountId, SerialNumber, CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SerialNumber,TGT.SerialNumber) AS SerialNumber
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.SerialNumber = TGT.SerialNumber
AND ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,'1') = ISNULL(TGT.CustomerId,'1')
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;


----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate =  CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  
AND  DELTA.SerialNumber = TGT.SerialNumber 
AND  ISNULL(DELTA.CustomerId,'1') = ISNULL(TGT.CustomerId,'1') 
AND  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND  DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
 AND SRC.SerialNumber = TGT.SerialNumber
  AND ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,'1') = ISNULL(TGT.CustomerId,'1')  
   AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31T00:00:00.0000000'




-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation  ( 
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,LinkCode
,DeletedIndicator
,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,ProfitCertificateIndicator
,VerifiedIndicator
,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SerialNumber
,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,CoreCustomerId
,CustomerRelationCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,NULL AS CustomerId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,NULL AS LinkCode
,SRC.DeletedIndicator AS DeletedIndicator
,SRC.GuarantorLiabilityPercentage AS GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,SRC.ProfitCertificateIndicator AS ProfitCertificateIndicator
,SRC.VerifiedIndicator AS VerifiedIndicator
,SRC.MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator AS MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,SRC.ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator AS ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SRC.SerialNumber AS SerialNumber
,SRC.RelatedPartyAllowedAmount AS RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,SRC.CoreCustomerId AS CoreCustomerId
,SRC.CustomerRelationCode AS CustomerRelationCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA 
 ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
  AND DELTA.SerialNumber = SRC.SerialNumber
   AND ISNULL(DELTA.CustomerId,'1') = ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,'1')
    AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;

END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CustomerAccountParticipation_TRY] AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(
SELECT
convert(varchar,BTL.ID) AS CustomerAccountId
,VALUE AS CustomerId
,convert(date,convert(varchar,BTL.INSERT_DTTM)) AS PeriodStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,BTL.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'TRY'AS SourceSystemCode
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
FROM (SELECT * FROM (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY ID) RN, * FROM BUSC.TRY_LegalEntity BTL --ON BTLD.ID = BTL.ID AND BTLD.Status = BTL.Status AND BTL.ISLATEST = 1
CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(BTL.External_Ref, '|')
where BTL.STATUS != 'Disabled'
AND (BTL.ROLES LIKE '%Client%' OR BTL.ROLES LIKE '%CounterParty%')
AND (BTL.FULL_NAME not like 'GROUP-%' OR BTL.FULL_NAME not like 'SETTLEMENT BANK%') AND BTL.ISLATEST = 1 AND VALUE <> ''  )A
--WHERE A.RN = 1
) BTL 
WHERE BTL.ID IS NOT NULL

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerId)
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,  CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation 
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerId)
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,  CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation
WHERE PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31' AND SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'TRY' 
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE
	WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
	WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;

--UPDATE RECORD TO BNKM
--
UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndDate =  CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND  DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND  DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
  AND SRC.CustomerId= TGT.CustomerId
   AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'





--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation
(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.PeriodEndDate)) AS PeriodEndDate
,SRC.CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,SRC.CustomerAccountParticipationNote AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'TRY' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.INSERTDTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA 
 ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
   AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
    AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;

END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTPARTICIPATION_SEC] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation AS (
SELECT 
	BST.ACCTCODE AS CustomerAccountId
	,BSA.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
	,NULL AS CoreCustomerId
	,CONVERT(datetime,BST.DATE_OPEN) AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BST.DATE_CLOSED AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS DeletedIndicator
	,NULL AS VerifiedIndicator
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
	,NULL AS GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
	,NULL AS ProfitCertificateIndicator
	,NULL AS MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
	,NULL AS ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
	,'NA' AS SerialNumber
	,NULL AS RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
	,NULL AS CustomerRelationCode
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
	,BSA.LINKCODE AS LinkCode
	,BSA.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'SEC'AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
FROM BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSA
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BST ON BSA.ACCTKEY = BST.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ACCTKEY = BST.ACCTCODE AND BST.isLatest = '1'
WHERE  BSA.isLatest = '1' 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
WHERE CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL AND PeriodStartDate IS NOT NULL;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC AS (
SELECT 
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
		convert(nvarchar,CustomerAccountId)
		,convert(varchar,CustomerId)
		,convert(varchar,LinkCode)
		)) AS HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, CustomerId, SerialNumber, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT AS (
SELECT 
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
		convert(nvarchar,CustomerAccountId)
		,convert(varchar,CustomerId)
		,convert(varchar,LinkCode)
		)) AS HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, CustomerId, SerialNumber, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA AS (
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartDate,TGT.PeriodStartDate) AS PeriodStartDate
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)



SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND  DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND  DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND SRC.CustomerId= TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'


INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation( 
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,CoreCustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,DeletedIndicator
,VerifiedIndicator
,CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,ProfitCertificateIndicator
,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SerialNumber
,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,CustomerRelationCode
,CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,LinkCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm

)
SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.CustomerAccountId
,SRC.CustomerId
,CoreCustomerId
,SRC.PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,DeletedIndicator
,VerifiedIndicator
,CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,ProfitCertificateIndicator
,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SRC.SerialNumber
,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,CustomerRelationCode
,CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,LinkCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
